title: Kochi museums: collections and practical details
description: Compare five Kochi-area collections and find practical information for planning a museum visit.
intro: Choose between royal history, maritime exhibits and Kerala art. The notes highlight what each collection covers and useful details from the cited sources; confirm current opening hours, fees and access with each venue before travelling.

entries.name: Hill Palace Museum
entries.description: The former royal residence in Thrippunithura now houses an archaeological and heritage collection, including royal objects, manuscripts and sculptures. Kerala Tourism says photography is prohibited inside the museum and visitors remove footwear before entering the archaeological building.
entries.details: Thrippunithura · royal history · indoor photography restriction

entries.name: Maritime Museum
entries.description: Situated at INS Dronacharya in Fort Kochi, this collection uses two former ammunition bunkers to present Kerala’s maritime history and the evolution of the Indian Navy. Exhibits include models, maps and naval objects.
entries.details: Fort Kochi · maritime and naval history

entries.name: Indo-Portuguese Museum
entries.description: Located within the Bishop’s House compound in Fort Kochi, the museum presents objects associated with churches and Portuguese influence in the region. Its collection is arranged around altar, treasure, procession, civil life and cathedral themes.
entries.details: Fort Kochi · art and religious heritage

entries.name: Kerala Museum
entries.description: The museum describes three sections: a Kerala history display with a sound-and-light show, modern Indian art, and dolls. Its visitor guide identifies Pathadipalam as the nearest metro stop and says the bus stop is at its gate. Check current hours, admission and show availability with the museum before visiting.
entries.details: Edappally · history, art and dolls · Pathadipalam Metro

entries.name: Mattancherry Palace
entries.description: The palace collection includes murals and royal portraits associated with Kochi’s rulers. Kerala Tourism lists the museum as closed on Fridays; verify current visiting arrangements before travelling.
entries.details: Mattancherry · palace murals · Friday closure listed
